The Compromise of 1877 was an informal , unwritten deal that settled the intensely disputed 1876 U.S. presidential election .
The Compromise of 1877 was an informal , unwritten deal that settled the intensely disputed 1876 U.S. presidential election .
It resulted in the United States federal government pulling the last troops out of the South
and formally ended the Reconstruction Era
